create_CseAnnotationsAccumulator: create a CseAnnotationsAccumulator instance to collect DensePose annotations across multiple images
accumulate_instances: accumulate DensePose instance data from a single image into the CseAnnotationsAccumulator
pack_annotations: pack accumulated DensePose annotations into a single PackedCseAnnotations dataclass with concatenated tensors
review_PackedCseAnnotations: review the PackedCseAnnotations dataclass fields for x_gt, y_gt, vertex_ids, and bounding box tensors
refactor_do_accumulate: refactor the _do_accumulate method to handle additional DensePose ground truth attributes
